The '''Graveyard of Lost Ships''' was a collection of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which were drawn into orbit around a [[collapsed dwarf star]] by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Arakkus]]. The Graveyard consisted of five interconnected rings of ships all of which had been lured to the Graveyard with distress calls, in an attempt to make others suffer as he had suffered. The ships which were drawn to the Graveyard by the gravitational pull of the dwarf star. Incapable of escaping its grasp, the ships slowly began to plunge into the star, while most of the crews went insane and committed suicide.

The Graveyard was destroyed before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were captured aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. While trying to help Arakkus escape the doomed rings, the group unintentionally set off a series of [[negatron]] charges, placed throughout the Graveyard by Arakkus. This destroyed the connected ships and brought about Arakkus's death.
